name: MORT (LA MORTE)
description: Mort (also known as La Morte) is a specialized trick-taking card game for 3 to 5 players, traditionally played with a modified Tarot deck. Created by Matt Haller, it combines the structural depth of Bridge and Tarot with a unique 'Specialist' mechanic centered around the 'La Morte' card (the 13 of Trumps). It involves complex bidding, the ability to 'Drop Out' of a hand to avoid points, and a high penalty for being 'Fuori dal Tempo' (out of time) on the final trick.

content.text: Mort (also known as La Morte) is a specialized trick-taking card game for 3 to 5 players, traditionally played with a modified Tarot deck. Created by Matt Haller, it combines the structural depth of Bridge and Tarot with a unique 'Specialist' mechanic centered around the 'La Morte' card (the 13 of Trumps). It involves complex bidding, the ability to 'Drop Out' of a hand to avoid points, and a high penalty for being 'Fuori dal Tempo' (out of time) on the final trick.
Designed by Matt Haller as a modern homage to historical Italian Tarot games like Tarocchini, but with simplified bidding and scoring meant for faster play.
37 cards (A, K, Q, Cav, J, 10, 9, 8, 7) + 13 of Trumps (La Morte).

items.text: Five players: Play with 9 extra cards (two extra ranks per suit) plus Il Bagatto (1 of Trumps), highest Club. Ranks from high: Il Bagatto, A K Q C J 10 9 8 7 6 5.
Standard 52-card pack: International 52-card pack: 3–4 players have A K Q J 10 9 8 7 6; 5 players also have 5 and 4. Joker or unused Spade as La Morte; 2 of Clubs as Il Bagatto if needed.
Muck when all drop: If all players drop out, dealer may muck the deal (round abandoned, deal passes left) instead of restarting with a bid.
